text:
1800 is not a leap year (divisible by 400? No; divisible by 100? Yes, so not leap).  
October 17, 1800.  
Subtract 83 days:  
Back 17 days → October 1.  
Back another 30 days → September 1 (30 days before Oct 1).  
Remaining days: 83 - 17 - 30 = 36 days left.  
August has 31 days: Sep 1 back 31 days → August 1.  
Remaining: 36 - 31 = 5 days.  
Back 5 days from August 1 → July 27.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1800-07-27
